trust_decision.summary: Prompt template text stored in DbPrompt.template is rendered in-process by a plain jinja2.Environment, so a template expression that reaches Python internals executes as code; the render-time decision point is the environment construction at prompt_service.py:88 (used by _compile_jinja_template at :106 and the render at :2888), and the only earlier check is a regex/allowlist schema field validator that the advisory calls insufficient. The published fix flips the decision to a SandboxedEnvironment plus a service-level template validator, and must also close the str.format fallback that re-renders the same template when Jinja fails.

landing_point.why: The advisory names PromptService._render_template and an unsandboxed Jinja2 Environment; this Environment() construction is what the report points at, and every render funnels through it via _compile_jinja_template (:106) from _render_template (:2888).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about the Jinja Environment; template.format is a rarely-hit legacy fallback inside an except block, so it looks like it does not render user templates at all.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Prompts fetched without arguments are returned as the raw, unrendered template text (and federated prompts with an empty template are proxied upstream); rejecting, escaping or re-validating templates at read time breaks argument-less prompts and the documented text passthrough.

O6_input_shapes: plain string template / plain string resource content
bytes resource content decoded with utf-8 errors=ignore before scanning
dict inputSchema serialized with orjson.dumps before scanning
encoding-obfuscated strings: HTML entities, percent-encoding, null bytes, Unicode NFKC, normalized before matching
content larger than CONTENT_PATTERN_MAX_SCAN_SIZE rejected before regex
templates with balanced vs unbalanced {{ }}, {% %}, {# #} delimiters
template with no Jinja delimiters at all

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Federated gateway prompt sync writes DbPrompt.template directly from upstream prompt data, entering the same template column that prompt_service.py:2021 renders; this path runs neither the schema template validator nor the fix's validate_prompt_template.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Federated prompts are assumed to be executed on their source gateway, so the locally stored template is assumed never to be rendered (only true when the template is empty, mcpgateway/services/prompt_service.py:354).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate service module (services/gateway_service.py, ~6k lines) with no import path from the prompt_service landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: resource update path scanning content while resource create is the only scanned path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Create and update are written as separate methods with duplicated validation blocks; the fix itself had to add the scan to both, so a maintainer wiring only one is an ordinary omission.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: tool metadata scan present on register_tool but absent on update_tool
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: update_tool duplicates only part of register_tool's checks; name/description/inputSchema are re-validated only if someone remembers the second method.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: resource/tool/prompt rows built directly in gateway_service instead of through the owning service
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Federation sync deliberately bypasses the per-entity services to batch-insert; every protection added to those services silently skips this path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: restore-from-backup builds PromptCreate/PromptUpdate directly and relies on the schema validator
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The importer is a separate serializer/deserializer layer whose behaviour is defined by saved artefacts, not by the request handlers that carry the checks.
